name: Clean Cut
tagline: A raw recording goes in, the same video without pauses, false starts and retakes comes out.
description: The basic cleanup every recording needs. Dead air, false starts and earlier takes are removed and the last take of every line stays, so you sound like yourself on a good day. Nothing gets added, and you also get a cut list to keep editing in Resolve, Premiere or Final Cut.
bring: A raw recording of you talking: to camera, over a screen recording, a talk or a podcast
Optional: how tight it should feel
get: The same video, shorter and clean, plus a cut list for your editor
steps: Find the pauses, false starts and repeated takes
Cut them out, keeping the last take of every line
Check every cut and export a cut list for your editor
Review it in FrameJam until it's right
